candidates.violated_requirement: The Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR operations to correctly decode the Gray code. Replacing XOR with OR in the conversion of bit 1 will cause incorrect binary values to be generated, leading to wrong Gray code outputs after the increment and conversion steps.
candidates.spec_basis: The implementation should follow this process: 1. Input a Gray code value (use an internal wire variable initialized to 0) 2. Convert the Gray code to binary representation
